claim: After the cyclic order-46 orientation no-go, the complete minimal noncyclic insertion spaces are the finite quotients C_M(h)/<h>, of orders four on the 46AB/2B rail and two on the 46CD/2A rail.

46AB.resolution: Q_46AB is the order-eight projection kernel modulo the central involution already contained in <h>
46AB.structureReason: the order-eight kernel lies in the extraspecial 2^(1+24) subgroup, whose quotient by its center <z> is elementary abelian

46CD.resolution: Q_46CD is the Baby-Monster order-23 centralizer modulo its order-23 cyclic subgroup

traceTarget.family: Z(g,z*k;tau) for k representing a coset of C_M(h)/<h>
traceTarget.orientationTest: compare each normalized trace with its fifth-power cyclotomic Galois transport between the distinct 46A/46B or 46C/46D Monster classes
traceTarget.transportType: Galois/power-map transport, not conjugation by a Monster normalizer element
traceTarget.success: at least one normalized auxiliary trace splits a 46A/46B or 46C/46D power-five pair
traceTarget.failure: all auxiliary traces are identified by centralizer conjugacy, modular covariance or power-five transport

boundaries: the order-four type uses the extraspecial quotient E/<z>, not order alone
distinct cosets need not give distinct trace functions
fifth power exchanges distinct Monster classes and therefore cannot be implemented by inner conjugation in the Monster
the order-four and order-two carriers are not identified with Rule-60 deck data or genus-two spin characteristics
failure exhausts scalar genus-one centralizer insertions but not vector-valued or genus-two refinements
